Reading.title: Meter Reading
Reading.description: A record of a meter reading at a specific point in time.

readingValue.description: The current value on the meter.

date.description: The date for which the reading is recorded (can be backdated).

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this reading.

units.description: Calculate units since the previous reading.

createdAt.description: When the record was created in the system.
